name: perl-digest-sha1
description: This tool calculates SHA-1 message digests for strings, data streams, and files using the Perl Digest::SHA1 module. Use when user asks to calculate SHA-1 hashes, perform data integrity checks, or generate checksums for files and incremental data streams.
overview: This skill provides guidance on using the `Digest::SHA1` Perl module to calculate SHA-1 message digests. While SHA-1 is no longer recommended for high-security applications due to collision vulnerabilities, it remains a standard for data integrity checks in legacy workflows, Git-like object hashing, and non-cryptographic checksumming. This tool allows for high-performance hashing of strings, data streams, and files.
